slots.fallback: Drawn in learn-art.tsx (HubArt): a winning hand of real tiles standing in its five groups on a blue felt rail, the groups lifting one after another, a rising price line behind and three loose tiles drifting above, on a blue halftone wash.
slots.brief: A first lesson on the trading floor: a dark blue felt mahjong table edge seen from slightly above, with a complete riichi mahjong hand of ivory tiles standing on it, split into four sets and a pair with small gaps between the groups (circle and bamboo faces only: dot patterns and green sticks). Behind it, a big soft stock-ticker line climbs from left to right like a chart on a wall screen, and two or three loose tiles float in the air above the hand at playful angles, as if just drawn. Hololive blue (#3fb8f5) light on dark ink (#0a0c11), flat shapes with halftone shading, friendly and inviting.
slots.notes: No letters, numerals, Chinese characters or symbols anywhere (no character, wind or dragon tiles, no numbers on the chart). No real talents or people. Must read on both themes: keep the background dark ink, the page frames it with a hairline.
